mcqs.question: Chandrayaan-4, India’s sample-return mission planned for launch by 2028, will land at which site in the lunar south-pole region?
options: MM-4 in the Mons Mouton region
IN-SPACe Satellite Bus as a Service (SBaaS)
mcqs.explanation: Chandrayaan-4 is planned to land at MM-4 in the Mons Mouton region near the lunar south pole. SBaaS is a satellite-bus service, while the Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology and the 2-nanometre chip relate to other science and technology developments.
